_comment: Directional energy intensity for LLM INFERENCE, by model SIZE CLASS, in Wh per 1,000 OUTPUT tokens. Output tokens dominate inference energy (generation is the costly part; R^2>0.95 vs output length in measurement studies). These are LOW-HIGH bands, not point values: serving choices (quantisation, batching, request shaping) move energy by up to ~100x for the SAME model, so a single number would be false precision. Keyed on size class, NOT named commercial products (vendors don't disclose serving hardware/batching). Estimate, not a measurement; for self-hosted/open models the band is most trustworthy. Replace with your own measured J/token before any non-directional use.
_sources: Directional, synthesised from peer-reviewed inference-energy measurement studies (2024-2026): arXiv 2509.20241 (median 0.34 Wh/query, IQR 0.18-0.67, for >200B models on an H100 node w/ realistic utilisation+PUE); arXiv 2505.09598 (~0.42 Wh short GPT-4o query); arXiv 2407.16893 (70B ~2 orders of magnitude more energy/token than small models; output length predicts energy R^2>0.95); arXiv 2601.22362 (quantisation/batching/shaping => up to ~100x spread, same model). Bands rounded by GreenPick. Assume a ~300-output-token 'typical query' when converting to per-query.

_notes.output_tokens_dominate: Energy tracks OUTPUT (generated) tokens + response time far more than input tokens. The tool keys on output tokens; if only total tokens are known, assume ~25-40% are output or flag the assumption.
_notes.moe: Mixture-of-Experts models run near their ACTIVE parameter count, not total — a '~400B MoE' behaves more like a mid/large dense model, NOT like dense-400B. Use the 'moe_frontier' class, not 'frontier_dense', for MoE.
_notes.serving_variance: quantisation (int8/int4), batching, and request shaping can cut energy many-fold; a naive un-batched fp16 deployment sits near the HIGH end. Hence bands, not points.

frontier_dense.label: frontier dense (>200B)
frontier_dense.example_models: dense >200B (research-scale); ~0.34 Wh median per typical query
